meta.title: Eduar Solaez — Automation Engineer & Software Developer
meta.description: Portfolio of Eduar Iván Solaez Olivera: process automation with n8n, Python/Java software development, applied AI, and cybersecurity in progress.

hero.tagline: I design automation workflows, microservices, and AI-powered tools that cut execution time and improve decision-making in real operations.

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a Systems Engineer specialized in process automation, software development, and systems integration, with experience in data analysis and geospatial information management.
I build solutions powered by Artificial Intelligence, Python, Java, and n8n to optimize operations, cut execution time, and improve decision-making for real-world teams.
I'm defined by analytical thinking, continuous learning, and a focus on technological innovation to solve complex problems through the strategic use of data and intelligent models.

bullets: Designed and implemented n8n automation workflows connecting applications, APIs, and operational systems.
Built microservices to support n8n workflows and other operational processes.
Developed Python desktop applications (backend and UI) to automate legacy apps, including Oracle BI report generation and Excel file processing.
Built an Android bot as an .aar library that uses accessibility services to automate a legacy app's interface for field staff.
Gathered operational requirements directly in the field, running the full cycle from requirements to solution delivery.
Implemented new AI technologies to automate operational processes and reduce manual tasks.
Built web tools and dashboards for data visualization and management.
Analyzed and visualized geospatial data using ArcGIS.
Contributed to digital transformation initiatives integrating AI and automation into business processes.
Provided level-1 technical support to users and computer equipment.
Verified and maintained proper functioning of lab equipment.
Installed, configured, and updated academic and administrative software.
Managed users and equipment through Active Directory.
